cues: The nervous system is the fast control system, working in milliseconds along fixed wires.
The central nervous system is the brain and spinal cord.

The peripheral system is twelve pairs of cranial nerves and thirty one pairs of spinal nerves: somatic for voluntary muscle, and autonomic for the organs, split into sympathetic, fight or flight, and parasympathetic, rest and digest.
